Apply Now
(Senior) Site Specialist (f/m/d)

Date: 08/05/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build

SAP has founded the Delos Cloud GmbH to deliver a vendor and solution-neutral sovereign cloud and accelerate the digital transformation of public services in Germany. Catering to the need for digitization in the public sector, the new company will act as a trusted partner providing an open sovereign cloud platform. With Sovereignty and Security at its heart, the cloud infrastructure offering is designed to meet the strict and unique national requirements set out by the German Government’s multi-cloud strategy.

Your responsibilities include:

Delos Cloud GmbH is growing and we are looking for a Physical Security (Senior) Specialist (f/m/d) for our existing and planned locations in Walldorf, Berlin and Frankfurt.

Do you enjoy and are passionate about being jointly responsible for implementing a safe working environment for our employees and protecting the assets of our young, up-and-coming company? Do you understand security as a holistic model in which responsibility and commitment are central pillars? Then apply now as a Physical Security (Senior) Specialist (f/m/d) to make Germany's digital future a little safer.

- You plan, implement and monitor all security measures for the company's locations assigned to you.
- Development and implementation of security policies, procedures and programs.
- You ensure that all security measures comply with applicable laws, regulations, certification and security standards especially related to sovereign Data Centers.
- You keep yourself up to date with current developments in the field of security and adapt security strategies and measures accordingly.
- You design concepts for security systems and infrastructures, considering the specific requirements and risks of the company or facilities. This includes identifying security gaps, selecting suitable technologies and developing solutions to ward off threats.
- You implement and operate access control measures according to national security and secrecy requirements.
- You ensure adherence to the federal government’s physical security demands including sabotage protection
- You work closely with external partners and internal teams such as facility management, the security team and on-site employees to build a comprehensive security infrastructure.

What you bring

- Completed degree in a security-related field or several years of professional experience in the security industry or a security-related authority (military, police, intelligence service), ideally in a managerial position.
- Comprehensive knowledge of security concepts, methods and technologies, ideally in data center security or in securing areas with high protection requirements.
- Extensive experience in the areas of: perimeter protection, mechanical burglary protection, locking mechanics and mechatronics, access control systems, burglar alarm systems and video surveillance.
- Experience in the development and implementation of security strategies and measures for locations or facilities.
- Strong understanding of compliance requirements and security standards. (IT-Grundschutz, C5, KRITIS, DIN 50600,..)
- Leadership skills and the ability to train, lead and motivate a security team.
- Ability to work effectively in a global and diverse environment.
- Do you respond to developments in the situation with fun and flexibility and are you an absolute team player?
- Excellent German language skills both in written and spoken language; English skills both in written and spoken language
- Residing in Walldorf / Berlin / Frankfurt (or) direct surroundings
- Regular mandatory on-call duty for night-time and weekend coverage required
- Willingness to go through personal security clearance (Government process)

Where you belong

SAP Government Security and Secrecy (GS2) organization is part of the SAP Customer Services and Delivery Board Area. This organization ensures strict liability fulfillment of customers’ national security requirements, business enablement in sensitive industries and compliance with Critical Infrastructure as well as Telecommunication regulations for SAP world-wide.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. jobs.occupation: Product Engineering / Team Lead (m/w/d) (Produktingenieur/in)
jobs.employer_name: WITec Wissenschaftliche Instrumente und Technologie GmbH
jobs.description:
Materials Analysis is an Oxford Instruments Business Unit that manages our Electron Microscopy and Mechanical Microscopy products, Atomic Force Microscopes, Raman Microscopes and Benchtop NMR Products. We are part of the wider Oxford Instruments Group that also includes Andor Technology, NanoScience, Plasma Technology and X-Ray Technology. With a sixty-year history, and fourteen Queen’s Awards for Enterprise, our world-class products and technologies are helping our customers to address the greatest challenges of the 21st century.

The Role

We are looking for a Team Lead of Project Engineering to lead our Product Engineering function and act as a key interface between R&D, Production, Operations and the wider business. This is a hands?on leadership role combining product engineering, compliance and quality management, ensuring robust release processes and high?quality, compliant products.

You will be responsible for structuring and running the “back?end” of R&D: establishing processes, managing documentation, guiding the team, and ensuring smooth transitions from development to production.

This is a highly visible on?site role within a collaborative R&D and production environment.

Key Responsibilities Product Engineering Leadership
• Lead and develop the Product Engineering team
• Own and manage Product Engineering processes, including: Design freezes, Pilot series, Iterative improvement loops, Process freezes and volume gates
• Coordinate cross?functionally with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain and Product Management to support smooth product launches
• Clarify technical issues, prioritise tasks and resources, and ensure delivery against timelines and cost targets
• Ensure transparent communication on technical feasibility, risks, timelines and costs
• Own BOM management and continuous improvement
• Drive continuous product improvements after process freeze
• Identify and close process gaps between R&D and Operations
• Oversee realisation of SCS solutions, coordinating technical planning, construction and production
• Facilitate lessons?learned sessions after major SCS projects to determine future productisation
• Contribute to strategic initiatives such as: ERP and PLM development, Modularisation and variant management, Digitalisation of technical processes and workflows
• Manage Product Engineering?related change and improvement processes across multiple departments

Compliance
• Coordinate compliance activities for all new products through pilot series
• Manage compliance challenges and escalations (e.g. customer?specific requirements)
• Organise and maintain compliance documentation
• Support CE and EMC/EMV?related activities
• Coordinate contributions from other departments where required
• Act as the internal interface to compliance experts (expert knowledge remains with the central compliance team)
• Support release processes requiring external compliance sign?off

Quality Management
• Take overall responsibility for internal production quality standards
• Establish systems to track, analyse and evaluate test and measurement data
• Ensure quality processes support production rather than create additional burden (smart, pragmatic tooling and workflows)
• Coordinate and support production in case of quality issues
• Act as R&D’s interface to the ISO responsible person, supporting: Process mapping and version control, Identification and closure of R&D process gaps in line with ISO requirements
• Drive the completion of documentation gaps within Product Engineering and coordinate closure across R&D

What We’re Looking For
• Strong experience with high?tech products in a product or project engineering environment
• Proven people leadership and team coordination experience
• Highly organised, structured, and pragmatic problem?solver
• Strong understanding of quality, compliance, release and industrialisation processes
• Background or training in Six Sigma, quality management or similar methodologies
• Experience working towards or within ISO?compliant environments
• Ability to balance “what is required” with a focus on delivering a truly excellent product
• Confident communicator, comfortable operating at the interface between engineering and the wider organisation
• Strong project management skills
• Willingness to attend training and further develop expertise in ISO, compliance and quality

Note to candidate: Please submit applications in English, with your CV and covering letter and your Referenzen. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial Teams call, with the opportunity to learn more about the role.
Applicants must be proficient in both English and German, with the ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken formats in both languages.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager New Opportunities Development (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Projektmanagement)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilitiesThe New Opportunities Development Team scouts opportunities for EIT Health to engage in collaborative project proposals, diversifying the organisation’s portfolio of grant-funded projects. The Team leads efforts to build strong proposals and bids across a variety of funding instruments, ensuring opportunities are pursued, structured and developed from early ideas into concrete concepts with a high chance of award by the relevant funding bodies

EIT Health delivers a portfolio of collaborative projects, supported by diversity of funding sources. To ensure a steady pipeline of new opportunities EIT Health is recruiting a Senior Manager, New Opportunities Development. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues in the New Opportunities Development Unit under the Director of Community and Stakeholders Engagement and transversally with relevant business units at EIT Health that have potential to engage in EU funded projects. jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe pulmonary diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Postdoctoral Scientist to join our Vascular Health Cluster within Innovation & Research (I&R).
This position focuses on understanding the role of the pulmonary vasculature in chronic lung diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis (PF) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). While epithelial injury has long been considered a key driver of disease progression, growing evidence highlights the pulmonary endothelium as a critical regulator of vascular remodeling, inflammation, tissue homeostasis, and fibrosis. Aberrant endothelial responses contribute to vascular dysfunction, increased permeability, altered angiogenesis, and pathological tissue remodeling.
As a postdoctoral researcher, you will drive the development of innovative in vivo models and advanced imaging approaches to investigate vascular remodeling and identify new opportunities for therapeutic intervention and drug triaging
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.
To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.
Tasks & responsibilities

- One of your key responsibilities will be to establish, characterize and validate novel in vivo models of pulmonary vascular pathologies, including aberrant angiogenesis, pathological vascular sprouting and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT).
- You will investigate vascular remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis and COPD and define robust, disease-relevant endpoints for mechanistic and pharmacological studies.
- In regard to quantitative vascular assessment, you will develop readouts for aberrant angiogenesis, vascular thickening, pulmonary vascular volume and structural changes within the pulmonary vasculature.
- Moreover, you will apply and further develop high-resolution micro-computed tomography (µCT) of isolated lungs and image-based quantification pipelines for vascular analysis.
- In addition, you will identify and evaluate tissue-based and circulating biomarkers associated with pulmonary vascular pathology and translate preclinical findings into novel therapeutic concepts.
- Furthermore, you will collaborate with internal and external experts, present your findings at scientific meetings and contribute to mentoring students and junior scientists where appropriate.

Requirements

- PhD in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Veterinary Medicine, Imaging Sciences or a related discipline.
- FELASA-B certification or an equivalent qualification that enables independent work with laboratory animals, together with hands-on experience in animal models.
- Experience with µCT imaging and/or advanced image analysis methods; experience with computational imaging or independent programming will be an advantage.
- Solid knowledge of molecular and cellular biology techniques, including flow cytometry (FACS), Western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, and protein and RNA analysis.
- Knowledge of pulmonary diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis and/or COPD; expertise in vascular biology, endothelial cell biology, angiogenesis or fibrosis research will be an advantage.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in written and spoken English; German language skills will be a strong advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.

We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

Core responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.
- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.
- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.
- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.
- Contribute to frameworks and tools with product-specific extensions as needed.
- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.
- Participate in release quality assessments.
- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.
- Do manual QA activities when needed.
- Participate in the test documentation creation.
- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.
- Work with the tooling team to adopt new frameworks and practices.

What we’re looking for

Required skills:

- Proven experience in test automation.
- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.
- Experience with test frameworks like JUnit or TestNG.
- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.
- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).
- Version control experience (Git).
- Proficiency in spoken and written English.
- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.
- Strong teamwork skills.
- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.

Nice to have:

- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.

**Why join JetBrains?**

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Qodana Core) (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

We build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.

In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.

Day to day, you will:

- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.
- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.
- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.
- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.
- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.
- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.

What you’ll bring

- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.
- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.
- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.
- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.
- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.
- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.

What you’ll need

- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).
- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.
- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.

What success looks like

- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.
- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.
- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

- Ways of working: - You demonstrate leadership, adaptability, and effective communication skills when collaborating with cross-functional teams - You are willing to travel occasionally within Germany, in some cases world wide
